errors.evidence: The fourth category label on the x-axis is “话” (huà), not “油” (yóu).
The eleventh category label on the x-axis is “空地” (kòngdì), not “空气” (kōngqì).
The description omits the category “地” (dì), which is located on the x-axis between “纸” and “白色”.
The value for the highest bar, “路”, is visibly below the 150 mark, at approximately 145.
The bar for “地方” is visibly above the 100 line, with a value of approximately 105.

errors.text_span: 其余名词的柱状图高度均低于100
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The bar for “地方” has a value greater than 100 (approx. 105).

errors.text_span: 且从“油”开始向右，柱状图高度呈逐渐递减趋势
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the decreasing trend begins from the fourth bar (which is also mislabeled as “油”). The chart shows that all bars are sorted in descending order from the very first bar, “路”.
The value for the shortest bar, “食物”, is approximately 25, not 10.
